name: mirage
text:
v1.0.5 is out: the chat with Claude is rebuilt from scratch.
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.5

- Only mirage answers the chat, always. The other two accounts never see it.
- No lease any more: the three accounts work at the same time and claim tasks so they don't double up.
- Your message shows at once and says where it is: Sending, Sent, Seen, Answered. Without a connection it keeps trying by itself; if GitHub refuses it, it says Not sent with Retry.
- Attachments are sent before the message and kept for good, and your pictures show in the chat.
- The top line says whether Claude is online, replying, working or being woken.
- The red number on the Claude tab counts only chat replies and clears when you open the chat.
- Your old chat is under the menu (⋮) › Show the old app's chat.

All you need to do is install v1.0.5.
